hidden_elements.boundary: STAGE anchors prove scenario/resource ownership; cross-stage counters and Bazaar chains remain explicitly labelled until their non-STAGE owners are decoded.

reference.boundary: Player-facing rules only. External conflicts are called out, but evidence locations are not rendered.
reference.primary: Game UI text extracted from the original disc and the project's global terminology.

timeline.boundary: Permanent joins, temporary participation, departures, pilot changes, PP transfers and unit powerups are included. Hidden acquisitions remain governed by hidden-elements.json.
timeline.usage: Acquisition timing and upgrade coverage are checked against the timeline, then rewritten with the project's global terminology.
